name: comet-card
blurb: Card with 3D tilt and a glare comet effect following the cursor.
description: Card that rotates and translates in 3D based on mouse position. A bright glare spot (comet) trails the cursor across the card surface. Highly customizable rotation and translation depth.
use_when: Premium product cards, hero highlights, or visually striking CTAs where the comet adds polish.
avoid_when: Touch devices or performance-constrained environments — the effect is computationally demanding.
a11y: Card content is readable. Tilt and comet are visual effects only.
